Fault script: kind=fault, type=fail-after-frame, fires_from_round=1, pre_fault_decisions=[a tool_call to query_metric_v1(metric_id=items_completed, ...)], http_error 503 'scripted_fault_fail_after_frame' from round 1 onward -- round 0 succeeds with a real, committed query_metric.v1 result/frame; the provider only fails on the SECOND round, after that frame already exists. Subject resolution: same reasoning as provider-fail.before-frame -- exact, deterministic preflight, independent of the provider round. Public outcome CORRECTED during Lane 2b merge/QA (2026-08-06), same basis as provider-fail.before-frame: PUBLIC_OUTCOME_BY_ERROR_CODE keys purely on the 'provider_unavailable' error code, not frame state, so TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE applies -- not FAILED (the sub-agent draft's guess). The committed round-0 frame is real evidence (protected by the CHAOS-3423 frame-write savepoint fix, d91fd769e, so it is not silently rolled back or duplicated), but it survives as a frame in the transcript, not as a client-facing answered_with_gaps DevAnswer -- this case exists specifically to prove that distinction holds (a partial frame existing is not the same as the run concluding gracefully, and is not the same as the run failing outright either).
